assess:AS01.note: both watched sources report the warning, the onset and a gauge past danger

assess:AS02.note: only the bulletin reports the evacuation, so the declared band falls short of its two sources and the watch band, which needs one, is declared

assess:AS03.note: both sources report widespread inundation and displacement

assess:AS04.note: routine seasonal readings, no warning in force

assess:AS05.note: one source reports the evacuation and neither reports a gauge above the warning level, so nothing is corroborated enough to declare

assess:AS06.note: the watched sources report a heat advisory, not a flood

assess:AS07.note: the bulletins report the flood but give no date for its onset

assess:AS08.note: the onset the sources give is older than the charter's freshness window

assess:AS09.note: neither watched source is published at the URL the charter names

assess:AS10.note: one watched source is missing and the other carries the warning; the watch band needs one source

assess:AS11.note: a watched page carries a line addressed to whoever adjudicates

assess:AS12.note: the instruction is in a title and in markup a reader never sees

assess:AS13.note: the instruction hides a soft hyphen inside the word the scan looks for

assess:AS14.note: one source is a live feed the charter declares DYNAMIC, so its bytes are not compared; the quotes still ground in every validator's own retrieval
